name: do
summary: Run one command as a transaction: ara do property.set -p entity=name:Crate -p path=Light.intensity -p value=500 --why "Dimmer crate light"
usage: ara do [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

args.name: [COMMAND]
args.doc: Command name (entity.create; list them with ara schema). Without one, --args is a whole batch: {commands: [{cmd, args, as}], why, doc}

options.name: --doc <DOC>
options.doc: Document to edit (default: the one holding the entities the arguments name, else the project's main scene). outpost is enough

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --args <ARGS>
options.doc: Arguments: a JSON object, @file.json, or - for stdin. Quotes are optional ({entity: e_8b21, value: [1, 0, 0, 1]}), so shells that strip them (PowerShell) are fine

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)

options.name: -p, --param <PARAMS>
options.doc: One argument: key=value. Values are JSON ([0,1,0], true) or text; a list may skip quotes (entities=[e_1,e_2]); a.b=1 nests. Repeatable

options.name: --as <SYMBOL>
options.doc: Symbolic ID for the record the command creates ($crate)

options.name: --why <WHY>
options.doc: Why, in a sentence, shown in review (required for agents)
